distinct from any diagnostic. No program, valid or not, should cause it.

points.text: Every code has a fixed severity: A error, C hygiene, D information, E reading.
Classes give the phase: lexical, syntactic, semantic or runtime.
With syntax errors no semantic analysis is done.
